Role & responsibilities




• Build and enhance AI-powered solutions for data governance and data-engineering SDLC. • Implement RAG pipelines and AI services over schemas, ETL logic, metadata, lineage, quality rules, and documentation. • Develop integrations with data platforms, metadata tools, CI/CD pipelines, and APIs. • Engineer reusable components for prompting, retrieval, embeddings, evaluation, and observability. • Create automated evaluations and guardrails to ensure accuracy, relevance, and low hallucination. • Embed security, governance, and traceability into all AI solutions. • Support deployment, monitoring, and operations using LLMOps/MLOps and DevOps practices. • Collaborate closely with solution leads, data engineers, and governance teams to refine and scale use cases. • Experience in Python using LLM APIs from foundational models & other orchestration platform
